issues.label: Definition of abuse under DVPA
issues.why: Court must apply the statutory definition of abuse in Family Code section 6203 to each party's claims.

issues.label: Disturbing the peace as abuse
issues.why: Section 6320 includes conduct that destroys a party's mental or emotional calm, which encompasses indirect contact and harassment.

issues.label: Indirect abuse via social media posts
issues.why: R.M.'s disparaging usernames and posts A.G. and others would see may constitute abuse disturbing her peace.

issues.label: Third-party contacts as abuse
issues.why: R.M.'s calls to A.G.'s mother and friend, disclosing private facts, may qualify as coercive control or disturbing peace.

issues.label: Coercive control
issues.why: Section 6320(c) recognizes coercive control including isolation, humiliation, and reputational harm as abuse.

issues.label: Mutual orders under section 6305
issues.why: Court cannot issue mutual DVROs without detailed findings that each acted as aggressor and neither primarily in self-defense.

issues.label: Primary aggressor determination
issues.why: Section 6305 requires identifying the dominant aggressor considering relative injury and history.

issues.label: Self-defense evaluation
issues.why: A.G. claims her scratching was self-defense, which bars an order against her under section 6305.

issues.label: Improper temporal limitation of evidence
issues.why: Court repeatedly barred pre-December 2023 evidence though DVPA permits consideration of the entire relationship history.

issues.label: Past abuse relevance to future harm
issues.why: Section 6301(c) requires past abuse alone can support a DVRO regardless of recency.

issues.label: Consideration of A.G.'s abuse allegations
issues.why: Court appeared to disregard A.G.'s detailed strangulation, assault, and coerced-sex allegations.

issues.label: Sexual assault/coerced sex as abuse
issues.why: Alleged coerced intercourse constitutes sexual abuse under the DVPA requiring evaluation.

issues.label: Strangulation evidence
issues.why: Photographs and police documentation of neck bruises are significant evidence of dangerous abuse.

issues.label: Weight of corroborating evidence
issues.why: Neighbor statements, friend declarations, and R.M.'s admissions corroborate A.G.'s abuse claims.

issues.label: R.M.'s admissions of violence
issues.why: Texts admitting to hurting A.G. physically, breaking in, and smashing her phone are party admissions.

issues.label: Threat with firearm image
issues.why: R.M.'s gun photo text to A.G.'s friend may show a credible threat of violence.

issues.label: Effect of A.G.'s recantation
issues.why: Court must weigh A.G.'s recanted police statement in light of domestic-violence recantation dynamics.

issues.label: A.G.'s repeated unwanted contacts
issues.why: Over a thousand contacts and appearances at R.M.'s home may constitute harassment/stalking abuse.

issues.label: A.G.'s admissions of harassing conduct
issues.why: A.G. admitted incessant, hostile contact she conceded was wrong, supporting an order against her.

issues.label: Whether R.M. reasonably feared abuse
issues.why: His claim of fear must be assessed given he taunted A.G. and delayed blocking her.

issues.label: Cessation of contact before petition
issues.why: A.G. stopped contact a month before R.M.'s petition, bearing on necessity of restraint.

issues.label: Provocation and taunting by R.M.
issues.why: R.M.'s social media taunts may have provoked contact, affecting aggressor/self-defense analysis.

issues.label: Likelihood of future abuse
issues.why: DVRO issuance requires assessing probability of recurrence for each party.

issues.label: Self-represented litigant assistance
issues.why: Court must afford unrepresented A.G. a fair opportunity to present her case.

issues.label: Due process at evidentiary hearing
issues.why: Restricting A.G.'s testimony may have denied her a meaningful opportunity to be heard.

issues.label: Even-handed treatment of parties
issues.why: Court permitted R.M.'s harassment narrative but curtailed A.G.'s abuse narrative, raising fairness concerns.

issues.label: Impact of drug use on credibility
issues.why: Both parties' drug use may affect credibility and context of behavior.

issues.label: Mental health considerations
issues.why: A.G.'s suicidality and R.M.'s 'pleasekillurself' post bear on abuse severity and safety.

issues.label: Encouraging suicide as abuse
issues.why: R.M.'s username telling A.G. to kill herself, timed to her message, may be egregious abuse.

issues.label: Disclosure of private information
issues.why: Revealing A.G.'s stripper history and intimate photos may constitute abuse invading privacy.

issues.label: Prior dismissed TRO significance
issues.why: A.G.'s earlier dismissed TRO request may be relevant but not dispositive.

issues.label: Dating/cohabitant relationship qualifying under DVPA
issues.why: Court must confirm the parties fall within DVPA-covered relationships.

issues.label: Scope of protected persons
issues.why: R.M. sought protection for family members, requiring findings on their inclusion.

issues.label: Credibility determinations
issues.why: Conflicting accounts require the court to make and support credibility findings.

issues.label: Adequacy of statement of reasons
issues.why: DVPA rulings, especially mutual orders, require sufficient findings for appellate review.
